feeds.title: Fern & Fossil Blog
feeds.description: Fern & Fossil blog provides all-inclusive instructional articles and workshops on plants. Fern & Fossil offers plants, terrariums, jewelry, and unique artifacts designed for those who want a small reminder of nature wherever they are. At Fern & Fossil, we believe growing and caring for plants can make people happier. Our goal is to create better and more beautiful environments.

feeds.title: Terrarium Blog
feeds.description: Learn everything about closed terrariums. Complete guides, extensive explanations, tips & tricks, ideas, interesting knowledge as well as product reviews are bundled up on the Terrarium Blog so you have all the information you could ever need.

feeds.title: Urban Born Blog
feeds.description: Know more about terrariums on Urban Born Blog. At Urban Born, we are selling handmade terrariums, lanterns, and More. The mission of Urban Born is to bring the beautiful art of Moradabad's artisans to the western world. We're confident you and your family will love your Urban Born terrariums.

feeds.title: Doodle Bird Terrariums Blog
feeds.description: Explore recent blog posts on Terrariums. Doodle Bird Terrariums shop was founded by Patricia Buzo out of her love of plants and creating unique works people would treasure. Each terrarium she creates is handcrafted using the highest grade plants and supplies, and she has learned to carefully package these fragile vessels so that they arrive safe and sound.

feeds.title: Terrarium Tribe Blog
feeds.description: Terrarium Tribe is a place for plant lovers, nature enthusiasts, artists, would-be botanists, and anyone interested in terrariums. We believe that terrariums are the perfect way for people to reconnect with nature. If you're looking for a way to express your creativity and love for plants, we can help. Here, we provide a space for people to learn and share their knowledge, green-fingered successes, and experiences.

feeds.title: SerpaDesign Blog
feeds.description: Check it out to see what the latest news is at SerpaDesign. I am Tanner Serpa, I'm an artist, designer, photographer, nature lover, DIY fanatic, and owner of SerpaDesign Blog. At SerpaDesign, I believe that nature design (house plants, terrariums, aquariums, etc.) produces a better quality of life. Serpa Design is dedicated to inspiring others through education and entertainment.

feeds.title: Rootbox Blog
feeds.description: Find terrarium DIY guides, terrarium ideas, terrarium designs, and more. At Rootbox, we make germination kits to make growing plants and herbs at home easy. Our terrarium kit provides you with all the ingredients you need to make your very own masterpiece. You can customize it as appropriate by buying your plant to put your stamp on your creation.
